variants.variant: absent capability / capability flag false / custom dialect default Supports=false => NotSupportedException (fail closed before any SQL)

tests.name: NextORM.Integration.Tests.DialectCapabilityContractTests.SupportedCapabilityObjects_ShouldRenderWithoutThrowing

tests.name: NextORM.Integration.Tests.DialectCapabilityContractTests.SessionIdentity_ShouldBeOptedIntoBySqlServerOnly

tests.name: NextORM.Integration.Tests.DialectCapabilityContractTests.SupportsSessionIdentity_ShouldRemainADefaultInterfaceMethod
tests.assertion: the member stays a default interface method (IsAbstract == false) so a pre-existing custom ISqlServerFunctions keeps the fail-closed default

tests.name: NextORM.Core.Tests.SessionIdentityInMemoryTests.SqlServerIdentity_WithoutTheSurfaceFlag_ShouldFailClosed
tests.assertion: custom dialect whose session renderer CLAIMS sqlserver.server_name but whose ISqlServerFunctions keeps the default flag=false => NotSupportedException with *server_name*

tests.name: NextORM.Core.Tests.SessionIdentityInMemoryTests.SupportsSessionIdentity_ShouldBeADefaultInterfaceMethod
tests.assertion: an external/legacy ISqlServerFunctions implementation keeps SupportsSessionIdentity == false (default interface implementation)

tests.name: NextORM.SqlServer.Tests.SessionIdentitySqlGenerationTests.SessionInfoKeys_ShouldRenderNativeSqlOrFailClosed
tests.assertion: 20 theory rows; the 10 unsupported keys assert Supports(key)==false AND Render(key) throws NotSupportedException

tests.name: NextORM.SqlServer.Tests.SessionIdentitySqlGenerationTests.NewIdentityFunctions_ShouldGenerateSqlOrFailClosed
tests.assertion: expression-level path: the 10 unsupported keys throw NotSupportedException (message carries the method name) before any SQL is produced

tests.name: NextORM.SqlServer.Tests.SessionIdentitySqlGenerationTests.SqlServerFunctions_ShouldOptIntoSessionIdentity
tests.assertion: positive half of the flag: SqlServerDialect.SqlServerFunctions.SupportsSessionIdentity == true

variants.notes: All 8 commands exit 0. The capability-absent branch (no ISqlServerFunctions object at all) is asserted by a7; the false-flag branch by a1 (custom dialect) and a8 (DIM shape).

variants.variant: SQL Server NULL propagation for the 6 nullable string identities (server_name, host_id, host_name, app_name, suser_name, original_login)

tests.name: NextORM.Integration.Tests.SqlServerSpecificTests.SessionIdentity_SqlServerFunctions_ShouldExecuteAndMatchNativeValues
tests.assertion: executes on a real SQL Server: server-reported identities (@@SERVERNAME/SUSER_NAME/ORIGINAL_LOGIN) are non-null; the client-reported ones (HOST_ID/HOST_NAME/APP_NAME) assert (value is null || value.Length > 0) - a SQL NULL is never substituted by ''; every projected value is cross-checked against the native expression on the same held connection

tests.name: NextORM.Core.Tests.SessionIdentityInMemoryTests.NetworkAddress_ShouldMaterializeSqlNullAsNull
tests.assertion: the shared string? scalar mapper returns CLR null for DBNull.Value / null and the value otherwise (the same reader path the 6 SQL Server string? identities use)

variants.caveat: No test FORCES a SQL NULL for HOST_ID/HOST_NAME/APP_NAME (they are non-NULL client values in the container): the null branch of those exact columns is asserted structurally (`is null || Length > 0`) plus generically by the core string? NULL-materialization test. A forced-NULL fixture for the client-reported columns would be a new test (PLAN/CHECK call), not written here.

variants.variant: connection_id unsigned (ulong) boundary - max/zero materialization, no numeric narrowing

tests.name: NextORM.Core.Tests.SessionIdentityInMemoryTests.ConnectionId_ShouldMaterializeTheWholeUnsignedRange
tests.assertion: the compiled reader mapper for a ulong column returns ulong.MaxValue, 0 and 4_294_967_296 unchanged (no sign/width narrowing)

variants.variant: in-memory provider fail-closed for the 15 new identity functions (no local/default evaluation)

tests.name: NextORM.Core.Tests.SessionIdentityInMemoryTests.IdentityFunctions_ShouldFailClosedInMemory
tests.assertion: 15 theory rows (one per identity key): each call on the InMemory context throws NotSupportedException instead of being evaluated locally or returning a default
